title: Why You Freeze Instead of Fight (It's Not Weakness)
description:
A rabbit in the open doesn't run when the hawk's shadow crosses. It goes still, heart pounding, completely frozen. You've done the same thing — in a meeting, in a doorway, in the moment you still call cowardice. It wasn't.

Fight-or-flight is only the middle rung. Below it is a defense cascade your willpower doesn't get to vote on: freeze, tonic immobility, shutdown. This video explains why your body sometimes decides that doing nothing is the last available way to survive — and why that's biology, not failure.

Autopilot makes calm, research-grounded explainers about the predictive brain — why you think, feel, and act the way you do. No hype, no quick fixes. Just the mechanism.

This video is for education only and is not medical or psychological advice.
